purpose: SPoM (Signed Poisson Shape Analysis) provides a C++ CLI module (PoissonShapeAnalysis) for 3D Slicer that performs statistical shape analysis between two groups of 3D binary shape volumes using the 3D Poisson equation, outputting a mean shape volume and surface mesh with per-vertex p-values. It is intended for neuroimaging and medical image researchers comparing anatomical shapes across cohorts.
summary:
SPoM provides the `PoissonShapeAnalysis` C++ CLI module for statistical shape analysis between two groups of 3D binary volumes using the 3D Poisson equation. All three admission requirements are met: the code has no malicious behavior or network/environment side effects, is licensed under the 3D Slicer license (`License.txt`) with permissive headers in `PoissonShapeAnalysis/lib/`, and has a valid catalog entry and CMake build configuration. Non-blocking issues to address include removing leftover debug file writes (`group1_*.nrrd`, `group2_*.nrrd`, `outsidePoisson.nrrd`, `insidePoisson.nrrd`, `indexMap.nrrd`, `m_meanShapeSurface.vtp`) to the current working directory, updating the template CTest arguments, and removing the unused `jjj/` directory.

🟢 Recommend merge

safety.rationale: Inspected all CMake, C++, XML, and Python files in the repository at commit e6333cce57ef2ee2b1f2baf02b2cf90fe690e3c6. There is no network activity, telemetry, external command execution, or unsafe deserialization.

environment.rationale: Inspected all CMakeLists.txt files and source files; the extension only builds a C++ CLI module (`PoissonShapeAnalysis`) using bundled ITK and VTK, without modifying Slicer's Python environment or installing packages.

packaging.rationale: Inspected the catalog entry and `CMakeLists.txt` / `PoissonShapeAnalysis/CMakeLists.txt`. `EXTENSION_DEPENDS` is `"NA"` matching `build_dependencies: []`, and `PoissonShapeAnalysis` builds cleanly as a CLI module via `SEMMacroBuildCLI`.

license.rationale: Inspected `License.txt` (3D Slicer Contribution and Software License Agreement v1.0) and the permissive MIT-style copyright headers by Yi Gao across all files in `PoissonShapeAnalysis/lib/` (noting `studentTtest.h` uses a clean-room incomplete beta implementation with no GPL/ALGLIB code).

soundness.rationale: Inspected `PoissonShapeAnalysis.cxx`, `PoissonShapeAnalysis.xml`, and all headers in `PoissonShapeAnalysis/lib/`. The C++ library leaves several debug `writeImage` and `writePolydataToXMLFile` calls active that write to relative paths in the current working directory (and `raise(SIGABRT)` if writing fails), and the CTest configuration still passes `--sigma 2.5` from the CLI template.

utility.rationale: Inspected `README.md` and `PoissonShapeAnalysis.xml`. The extension implements a published statistical shape analysis method (Gao & Bouix, Medical Image Analysis 2016) with clear usage documentation in `README.md`.

findings.title: Unconditional debug file writes to current working directory can fail or litter user directories
findings.explanation: The C++ library unconditionally writes several debug files using relative filenames into the process's current working directory during normal execution: `group1_%lu.nrrd` and `group2_%lu.nrrd` in `SumOfTwoPoissonShapeAnalysis.hxx` (lines 140-152), `m_meanShapeSurface.vtp` in `SumOfTwoPoissonShapeAnalysis.hxx` (line 403), `outsidePoisson.nrrd` and `insidePoisson.nrrd` in `ShapeSumOfTwoPoissonFilter.hxx` (lines 202-203), and `indexMap.nrrd` in `DirichletPoissonSolver3D.hxx` (line 175) and `NeumannDirichletPoissonSolver3D.hxx` (line 175). If the current working directory is read-only (for example, Slicer's installation directory on Windows or macOS), `writeImage` catches `itk::ExceptionObject` and calls `raise(SIGABRT)`, crashing the CLI execution; if the directory is writable, it silently litters or overwrites files in the working directory.
findings.suggestion: Remove or comment out the debug `writeImage` and `writePolydataToXMLFile` calls across `SumOfTwoPoissonShapeAnalysis.hxx`, `ShapeSumOfTwoPoissonFilter.hxx`, `DirichletPoissonSolver3D.hxx`, and `NeumannDirichletPoissonSolver3D.hxx`.

findings.title: CLI test uses leftover template arguments (--sigma) that do not match the CLI XML parameters
findings.explanation: `PoissonShapeAnalysis/Testing/Cxx/CMakeLists.txt` still contains the default CLI template test invocation passing `--sigma 2.5` and positional arguments, which do not match `PoissonShapeAnalysis.xml` (`--shapeNameList1`, `--shapeNameList2`, `--meanImageName`, `--meanVTKName`, `--doRegistration`). Running ctest will fail on this test.
findings.suggestion: Update the CTest command in `PoissonShapeAnalysis/Testing/Cxx/CMakeLists.txt` to pass valid input folders and output paths matching `PoissonShapeAnalysis.xml`.

findings.title: Unused scratch module directory `jjj/` and `.vscode/settings.json` committed to repository
findings.explanation: The repository contains an unused prototype scripted module folder `jjj/` (with broken recursion in `jjjLogic.process` at line 366 and leftover template code) as well as `.vscode/settings.json` with a hardcoded local path. Although `jjj` is not added via `add_subdirectory` in the root `CMakeLists.txt` and therefore does not break the build, removing unused scratch directories keeps the repository clean.
findings.suggestion: Remove the unused `jjj/` directory and `.vscode/settings.json` from the repository.

not_checked: Binary image files SlicerSPoM.png and SlicerSPoMScreenShot.png and binary test data under PoissonShapeAnalysis/Data/ were not rendered or executed.
questions_for_author: Could you remove the unconditional debug file writes (`group1_*.nrrd`, `group2_*.nrrd`, `m_meanShapeSurface.vtp`, `outsidePoisson.nrrd`, `insidePoisson.nrrd`, `indexMap.nrrd`) from the C++ headers so the CLI does not write into or crash on a read-only working directory?
